text: The schema-URL reviewer asks for IAN_SCHEMA_VERSION so the server schema is not confused with client VERSION/LOCALE placeholders. The author agrees; the assigned source uses %IAN_SCHEMA_VERSION%, a _SCHEMA_VERSION value of 2.0 and a comment that explains schema substitution before generic URL formatting. The proposed _IAN_SCHEMA_VERSION property spelling is not the landed field, and v2 is not the landed schema string. Acceptance also requires resetting the changed URL preference; exact historical test source does so with setStringPref. Existing source knowledge already covers the two-stage mechanism. This note adds its local naming reason and source-matched review outcome, not a global token or field-style rule. Available Bug history records code and documentation landing separately. Partial historical evidence: own comments1/2 unavailable; no new runtime validation.
title: Name the notification schema token separately from client version placeholders
